build_reranker_score: run the jina-reranker-v3 model to score query-document pairs using llm.score
create_llm_pooling_instance: create a vLLM LLM instance with pooling runner for the jina-reranker-v3 model
encode_documents_query: encode documents and query into token embeddings using llm.encode with pooling_task token_embed
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between query and document embeddings using torch.nn.functional
run_reranker_script: run the jina-reranker-v3 offline scoring and embedding script as a standalone module
